author: Ari Koslow
title: Wyatt Langford (hamstring) scratched from lineup Saturday
desc: Wyatt Langford was a late scratch from Saturday's lineup against the Blue Jays.
impact: Langford is dealing with left hamstring tightness. He'll continue to be further evaluated.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Andrew Abbott labors on mound in win over Pirates
desc: Andrew Abbott allowed three earned runs on six hits and one walk while striking out six over 5 1/3 innings in Friday's win over the Pirates.
impact: Abbott has offered mixed results on the mound of late, allowing three earned runs or more in four of his last eight trips to the mound. The left-hander remains one of the more stable starting options in the Reds rotation for manager Terry Francona while fighting inconsistent command, carrying a 3.90 ERA and 1.41 WHIP with a 5-4 record and 1.8 K/BB ratio through 17 starts.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Cal Raleigh moved down to sixth in lineup Saturday
desc: Cal Raleigh was moved down in the order to hitting sixth on Saturday against the Guardians.
impact: Raleigh is hitting just .182 since returning from the injured list earlier in June. Dominic Canzone was moved up in the order to hit third.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Josh Simpson recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Mariners recalled Josh Simpson from Triple-A Tacoma.
impact: Simpson will hold a middle-relief role in the Mariners bullpen.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Patrick Corbin shelled early as Blue Jays fall to Rangers
desc: Patrick Corbin allowed five earned runs on seven hits and one walk while striking out five over 4 1/3 innings in Friday's loss to the Rangers.
impact: Corbin has provided mixed results on the mound of late, allowing three earned runs or more in four of his last eight trips to the mound. The left-hander remains difficult for fantasy managers to trust in the Blue Jays rotation, posting a 5.09 ERA and 1.55 WHIP with a 2-4 record and 2.2 K/BB ratio across 15 starts.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Alex Hoppe optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Mariners optioned Alex Hoppe to Triple-A Tacoma.
impact: Hoppe will return to Triple-A. Josh Simpson was recalled as the corresponding move.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Kazuma Okamoto goes deep in loss to Rangers
desc: Kazuma Okamoto went 2-for-4 in Friday's 5-4 loss to the Rangers with a two-run home run.
impact: Okamoto continues a productive stretch, driving in runs in five of his last six contests. The rookie remains another streaky bat in the Blue Jays lineup for manager John Schneider, slashing .245 with 19 homers, 53 RBI, and 43 runs through 80 games.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Cole Ragans (elbow) to undergo surgery Wednesday
desc: Cole Ragans will undergo elbow surgery on Wednesday.
impact: Per Rogers, the extent of the surgery will be determined once they get inside and see exactly what's going on. There will be an update provided on how long Ragans is expected to miss.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Erasmo Ramirez released by Rockies
desc: The Rockies released RHP Erasmo Ramírez.
impact: Ramirez did not make it to the majors after signing a minor league contract with Colorado.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Tyler Beede released by Cubs
desc: The Cubs released RHP Tyler Beede.
impact: Beede did not reach the majors after signing a minor league contract with the Cubs. He'll figure to seek another opportunity.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jorge Polanco (Achilles) to begin rehab assignment Saturday
desc: Jorge Polanco will begin a rehab assignment on Saturday with Triple-A Syracuse.
impact: Polanco will be back in game action for the first time since April 14. He is likely to require a lengthy rehab assignment.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Cade Povich activated from IL, optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Orioles activated Cade Povich from the 15-day injured list and optioned him to Triple-A Norfolk.
impact: Povich concluded his rehab assignment earlier this week. He will remain in Triple-A.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Kyle Nicolas designated for assignment
desc: The Orioles designated Kyle Nicolas for assignment.
impact: Nicolas loses his spot on the Orioles 40-man roster. He will head to waivers.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Dom Keegan claimed off waivers by Orioles
desc: The Orioles claimed Dom Keegan off waivers from the Rays.
impact: Keegan was designated for assignment by Tampa Bay. He'll add catching depth for Baltimore.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Kevin McGonigle swipes two bases in win over Astros
desc: Kevin McGonigle went 1-for-2 in a win over the Astros with two walks, two runs scored, and two stolen bases.
impact: McGonigle continues a scorching stretch at the plate, collecting hits in 11 of his last 12 contests. The infielder remains one of the few impactful options as part of an underperforming Tigers lineup for manager AJ Hinch, carrying an .817 OPS with six home runs, 28 RBI, 49 runs scored, and 11 stolen bases across 79 games.
